description: Mandates (Record §9.6 to §9.10): the document tzun-mandate/1, the statement tzun-signoff-mandate/1 without a printed name, the assertion digest, predicates, scope, single-record limits, consumption over a set of records, the issuance row (Verification §4.12), event bodies and their digests, the claim a capture under a mandate makes, and the lifecycle refusals.
source: Generated by scripts/generate-mandate-vectors.ts. Every expected answer is written in the script from the specification, and the script stops if the engine disagrees with one. W4's assertion is a real Ed25519 signature by the RFC 8037 Appendix A key; every other signature is a placeholder or a constructed ES256 encoding: the checks here read encodings and challenges, never whether a signature verifies. A predicates case with payloadJson is parsed by the implementation's own JSON reader, because the spelling of its number is the point.
